title: Trulimax (Azithromycin ) Non-Interventional Study In Acute Bacterial Upper Respiratory Tract Infections
brief_summary: To assess effectiveness of Trulimax (Azithromycin) in Acute Bacterial Upper Respiratory Tract Infections (URTIs).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Evidence of a personally signed and dated informed consent document indicating that the subject (or a legally acceptable representative) has been informed of all pertinent aspects of the study.
* Patients with acute URTI, presumed to be of bacterial origin as per the clinical judgment of the investigator.

Exclusion Criteria:

N/A
study_population: Only patients with acute URTI, presumed to be of bacterial origin as per the clinical judgment of the investigator will be enrolled in the study.
